post.summary: Identity bridge: exchange an external identity for a short token of the linked API key
post.description: For integrations (an INTEGRATION credential, or a SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR with `?userScope=backoffice`). The caller proves who the person is; Studio finds the API key standing for that identity — by (provider, subject), then by email — or creates one just-in-time when the email's domain is active in an organization's external domains, and mints a token that expires after `EXTERNAL_EXCHANGE_TOKEN_TTL` (default 1h). The token inherits the key's organization role. The long-lived key is never returned.

parameters.name: userScope
parameters.description: `backoffice` — required only when the caller is a SYSTEM_ADMINISTRATOR rather than an INTEGRATION credential

subject.description: Stable id of the person at the provider (e.g. the OIDC sub)

email.description: Email of the person (lowercased server-side); the pivot between systems and the input of the just-in-time creation

userId.description: id of the API key (a machine user)

created.description: true when the key was created just-in-time by this call

403.description: Caller is not an integration credential; the linked key has been revoked (`code: revoked`); or the key was provisioned for a domain that is no longer active (`code: domain_inactive`)

404.description: No key is linked to this identity and its domain is not active (`code: no_linked_key`)
